<script>
(function(){
  var OLD='£119', PCT='-25%';
  function promo(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.prices').forEach(function(p){
      var price=p.querySelector('.price'); var cmp=p.querySelector('.compare-at-price');
      if(!price||!cmp||!/£8\d/.test(price.textContent)) return;
      cmp.textContent=OLD; cmp.setAttribute('data-value','11900'); cmp.classList.add('cch-promo-old');
      var badge=p.parentElement.querySelector('.badge'); if(badge){ badge.classList.add('cch-promo-badge'); badge.style.display='inline-block'; var s=badge.querySelector('.badge__savings'); if(s) s.textContent=PCT; }
    });
  }
  promo(); setTimeout(promo,800); setTimeout(promo,2500);
  document.addEventListener('variant:change',promo);
})();
</script>

settings.title: Warm inside, even after frost
settings.text: Checked it at 6 am after a frost: the inside was noticeably warmer than the air and the blanket was dry. Our cat Biscuit hasn't slept anywhere else since.
settings.author: Laura M., Surrey

settings.title: Perfect for our feral
settings.text: We couldn't get near him, so no heated bed with a cable. This needs nothing. Placed it by the compost bin where he already slept; he was in it on night two.
settings.author: Andrew C., Nottingham

settings.title: Solid, just mind the flap at first
settings.text: Well made and clearly insulated. Our cat was wary of the flap for a few days, so I tucked it up as the guide suggests. Sorted. Four stars only because delivery took the full ten days.
settings.author: Gemma L., Cardiff

settings.text: The roof and door flap are lined with a reflective film. It works passively: it reflects your cat's own body heat back into the shelter instead of letting it escape into the night air. There's nothing to plug in, nothing to charge, and nothing that can run out of power on the coldest night. The walls are padded too, adding a second layer of insulation around your cat.

Cold isn't the only problem outdoors — damp is just as hard on a cat. This shelter stands on raised plastic legs, lifting it above wet grass, mud and standing water. The roof and door flap are water-resistant, built to shed rain rather than let it soak through. It's designed for the kind of weather the UK actually gets.
No tools, no instructions to lose. The shelter opens into shape in a couple of minutes and folds flat again when you need to store it, move it, or clean underneath it.

No outdoor shelter can promise total protection from every animal, and we won't claim this one does. What it gives your cat is an enclosed, private space to retreat into, off the ground and out of the open. For context, Cats Protection's own figures show fox attacks on cats are rare — around 5 in every 10,000 vet visits, compared with 541 for fights with other cats. We'd rather give you the real numbers than an empty promise.

A new shelter can sit untouched for the first few days — that's normal, not a fault. Our free guide covers where to place it, what to add so it smells familiar, and how to use food to encourage that first visit.
Reflective-lined roof and door flap, padded walls

How it compares

Cardboard and towels are the most common free option, but the RSPCA and Cats Protection both warn that damp cardboard loses its insulating value quickly in UK winters — it's why we built this instead.

settings.heading: Does it need electricity to keep my cat warm?

settings.text: No. It's insulated, not heated. The reflective lining and padded walls work passively, with nothing to plug in.

The roof and door flap are water-resistant and built to shed rain, and the raised legs keep the base off wet ground. We're not calling it fully waterproof until we've tested a sample ourselves in real UK rain.

settings.heading: Will it protect my cat from foxes?

settings.text: It gives your cat an enclosed, private space to retreat to — not a guarantee against any animal. Cats Protection's data shows fox attacks on cats are uncommon (about 5 in 10,000 vet visits). We won't claim “fox-proof.”

settings.heading: How many cats can it fit?

settings.text: It's designed for one cat to use comfortably. We'll confirm exact capacity once we've tested a sample.

settings.heading: How long does assembly take, and do I need tools?

settings.text: No tools needed. It opens into shape in a couple of minutes.
We're finalising exact care instructions after testing a sample — this answer will be updated once confirmed. In general, a wipe-down of the outer fabric is expected to be enough for everyday use.
Oxford fabric on the outside, with a reflective film lining the roof and door flap, and padded walls underneath.

settings.heading: Does it fold away for storage?

settings.text: Yes. It folds flat, so you can store it over summer or move it easily.
